scope: Read-only frozen source review and byte/hash checks. No GPU/model execution, test suite, runtime state modification or submission by this reviewer.
objective_boundary: Only A original focal scalar: N-based detached sequence TIS, original actor behavior mu, independent zero-scaling R, original clipped PG plus k3, fixed scale128 and complete pair denominator2. No G-detached reanchoring.
autocast_boundary: A:N0/R0 share original no_grad+autocast; A:G0 fresh grad-enabled autocast; no extra actor forward before backward.
graph_boundary: A:G0 retained scores hold real graph for one backward. All post grad scores/hidden are detached and original graph references released; CPU histories do not retain graphs. Existing A gradients remain until all post observations and final gradient measurement.
passive_observation: GC module vars, scalar flags, checkpoint callable source metadata, model __dict__ block flags. Checkpoint graph traversal uses next_functions and explicit custom ctx.__dict__ entries; does not read saved_tensors or automatically unpack _saved_* descriptors. Local strong node references prevent id reuse and are released when traversal returns.
mutations: No optimizer construction/step, clipping, parameter perturbation, saved-tensor hook installation or assignment into GC globals. Existing source-defined reference-scaling temporary zero/restore and initial/final zero_grad remain.
partial_evidence: Each actual forward observation is atomically written. backward-before precedes the actual backward; backward-after is only written after it returns and CUDA synchronization completes. Final summary requires exact adapter hash equality; carrier checks one backward and zero optimizer steps.
normalization_note: A-only retained gradient is not the old full-pair gradient; do not compare their norms as if equal objectives. The omitted r4 autograd.grad(scaled,current) was a scores-only diagnostic, not a second backbone backward.
inference_limits: One backward/checkpoint recomputation changes multiple states together; association alone does not identify the unique mechanism.
B is measured after A backward without a same-run B-before measurement; compare actual results with that limitation.
Passive metadata/CPU capture changes timing and object lifetimes; this preserves declared computation order, not every allocator timing detail.
Missing exposed checkpoint nodes/metadata cannot establish absence of offload compression.
If backward raises or is killed partway through, backward-before does not prove completion; use the actual after-record and terminal source-bound evidence.
